blocks.text: Student Learning Outcomes (is chapter mein kya seekhenge)
Is chapter ke aakhir tak aap yeh kar sakenge:

items: Network architecture (network ka design) aur us ke bunyadi concepts samajh aur samjha sakenge, aur network diagnostic tools (network ka masla dhoondne wale auzaar) aur commands achhi tarah chala sakenge.

Ghar ka network set up aur configure (settings theek karna) kar sakenge, network troubleshooting (masla dhoond kar theek karna) ki skill bana sakenge, aur network connections ki qismon (wired aur wireless) mein farq bata sakenge.

Network bandwidth (ek waqt mein kitna data ja sakta hai) aur latency (data pohanchne mein deri) samajh aur naap sakenge, aur network load balancing (kaam ko kai servers mein baantna), network security (hifazat), data backup (data ki copy) aur recovery (data wapas lana) ki ahmiyat samajh sakenge.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter computer networks ke bunyadi concepts sikhata hai aur batata hai ke devices aapas mein kaise baat karte hain. Students network architecture (network ka design), ahem components (hisse) aur network ke bunyadi kaam ke baare mein parhte hain. Is mein network models aur layers (tahein), khaas taur par OSI model, aur networks ki mukhtalif topologies (devices jorne ke naqshe) aur qismein shamil hain. Chapter aam networking devices bhi samjhata hai, jaise NIC, switch, router, modem aur wireless access point.

Students zaroori protocols (baat-cheet ke qaide) aur services se bhi waqif hote hain, jaise TCP/IP, HTTP, FTP aur DNS, aur IP addressing, IPv4/IPv6, subnetting aur NAT ke concepts se bhi. Woh seekhte hain ke ghar ka network kaise set up aur configure karte hain, wired (taar wale) aur wireless (baghair taar ke) connections samet, aur Wi-Fi security aur encryption (data ko khufia code mein badalna) samajhte hain. Ping aur ipconfig jaise network diagnostic tools ka istemal bhi aata hai. Aakhir mein chapter network performance (network kitna achha chalta hai), security ke tareeqe aur asal zindagi ke woh tareeqe batata hai jin se baat-cheet mehfooz aur achhi rehti hai.

blocks.prompt: Is chapter ke teen bare hisse kaun se hain (learning outcomes ke mutabiq)?
blocks.explanation: 1) Network architecture, bunyadi concepts aur diagnostic tools/commands. 2) Ghar ka network set up karna, troubleshooting aur connection ki qismein. 3) Bandwidth, latency, load balancing, security, backup aur recovery.

items: Chapter: devices aapas mein kaise baat karte hain, network ka design aur hisse.
Topics: network ki qismein, devices, topologies, OSI model, protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP, FTP, DNS), IP addressing, ghar ka network, Wi-Fi security, ping/ipconfig, performance, security, backup.
